title: Platform Settings
subtitle: Deployment-wide settings — apply to every family on this instance, not just one.
forbidden: You don't have permission to change this. Only the configured platform owner can update deployment-wide settings.

signIn.title: Sign-in methods
signIn.help: Controls whether sign-in and sign-up across the whole deployment can use Google, password, or either — separate from any one member's own sign-in method (set per-member on the Members page).
signIn.saveFailed: Could not save the platform sign-in policy.

retention.title: Activity log retention
retention.description: The default number of days activity history is kept for every family on this deployment that hasn't set its own value (Settings > System). Leave blank to fall back to this server's own configuration.
retention.label: Default retention (days)
retention.help: 30–3650 days. A family can still set its own value that overrides this.
retention.invalid: Activity log retention must be between 30 and 3650 days, or blank to use this server's default.
retention.saveFailed: Could not save the activity log retention default.

binRetention.title: Bin retention guidance
binRetention.description: Informational only — a guideline for how long deleted items are expected to sit in a family's bin before you clear them below. Nothing is ever deleted automatically, no matter what this is set to; every family's bin only empties when you permanently remove something yourself.
binRetention.label: Suggested days in bin
binRetention.help: 30–3650 days. Shown to you as a reminder only — it does not delete anything.
binRetention.invalid: Bin retention guidance must be between 30 and 3650 days, or blank.
binRetention.saveFailed: Could not save the bin retention guidance.

bin.title: Bin — permanently delete
bin.description: Every family's deleted documents, folders and vault items, across this whole deployment. Restoring something is a family's own job (their Bin page) — this is the only place anything is ever removed for good, files included. This cannot be undone.
bin.empty: No family's bin has anything in it
bin.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this. Only the configured platform owner can permanently delete bin contents.
bin.confirmDescription_one: {{count}} item and any files it contains will be removed for good. This cannot be undone.
bin.confirmDescription_other: {{count}} items and any files they contain will be removed for good. This cannot be undone.
bin.partiallyPurged: {{done}} of {{total}} removed permanently — {{failed}} could not be removed.
bin.purgeFailed: Could not permanently remove the selected items.

smtp.title: Email (SMTP)
smtp.description: Used to send password-reset links, invite emails and admin alerts for every family on this deployment. Leave a field blank to fall back to this server's own configuration.
smtp.hostHelp: The address of your email provider's outgoing mail server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com.
smtp.portHelp: Usually 465 or 587 — check with your email provider.
smtp.portInvalid: The SMTP port must be a positive whole number, or blank to use the default.
smtp.passHelp: Leave blank to keep the password already saved. Stored encrypted — it's never shown here again.
smtp.fromHelp: What recipients see as the sender, e.g. "Family Vault <noreply@example.com>".
smtp.saveFailed: Could not save the email settings.
